Excellent atmosphere and cute cats!
May 2019 • Friends
A wonderful little haven to tuck into on a hot day in HCMC. Nicely decorated with mellow lighting, extremely cozy, great service and a wonderful menu. Try the set lunch - literally just 2USD for 3 or so dishes. It changes daily so make sure to ask. There's also a great collection of beer and an even better collection of kittens. 

Everything about this place is great so check it out if you're nearby! Or even if you're far, the commute is worth it.

An awesome beer destination
Oct 2018 • Solo
I stumbled across this place quite by accident after it was recommended by a brewer friend from Hanoi. It seems to be modelled on the Budapest ruin pub concept and it works well in Saigon. The place is quite small downstairs but there is a second floor. It’s mainly locals here with a sprinkling of expats and tourists. The food was excellent and reasonably priced. The craft beer selection is one of the best in Saigon. There is Wi-Fi and the staff are friendly and attentive. English is well spoken here. Well worth a visit. It’s walkable from the city but take a Grab on a hot day. Google maps is close but not close enough. You will need to walk a little!

What a cool place with crap service
Aug 2018 • Couples
Really nice vibe here. Good mix of Vietnamese and Westerners. Interesting decor and artwork. I love the cats!! 
Apparently the baker was off (it was a Sunday night) so we couldn't order our first choice on the menu. 
I got the Wurst sausage combo, which didn't come with the garlic bread (baker issue) and it was a TINY portion. 
My boyfriend ordered the ribs, but they brought him the Wurst combo as well?! Eventually them came to us, took away his meal and brought out the ribs which were absolutely tiny as well. They took a long time so I had my little meal eaten by the time his came. (No apology along the way)
When we went to the bar to pay the girl was on her phone texting and we were waiting for her ages. 
Shockingly bad service but such a cool place!!!

Khoai is near on perfect !!!
Apr 2018 • Friends
I never write reviews, so to get my lazy bottom (I can't write the word I was going to write, as apparently tripadvisor class it as a profanity) to write a review after some 10+ years of reading them on tripadvisor a place was going to have to be very special. 

KHOAI is a fantastic find in a crazy city, a genuine chilled out bar and restaurant with very friendly Vietnamese staff that speak good English with a truely tasty food menu, a drinks list to meet every need and all very reasonably priced... In fact at 30,000 dong a bottle of tiger crystal it was the cheapest I've discovered in my 2 week trip so far (plus 20% off during happy hour).

If you want sterile surroundings, bland food and over-priced drinks then this is NOT the place for you. There are soooooooo many bars and restaurants either trying too hard or simply not trying at all, in Ho Chi Minh City. - Khoai is a great space, with lots of thought gone into it... mosquito spray on the tables, board games a plenty, pens in the (clean) toilets for graffiting the walls and sleeping cats that simply hang-out and look cute.

The owner 'Hi' (I think that's his name) popped over to our table and introduced himself and told us his inspiration for the bar came from Europe. As a person who has travelled extensively throughout Europe and have lived in East London for the past 10 or so years I would say he's bang on the money! - The background music was even spot-on and I am very fussy when it comes to tunes.

Over the 3 or so hours we were there we tried the deep fried olives, cheesy quesadillas (twice!), chicken wings, french fries and pasta milanese all of which was super yummy and highly recommend.

As we were leaving we asked them where the best place was to catch a taxi and they called us an uber car... now that's service! - Whether you are by yourself, a couple or a group of friends you will LOVE this place. - By the way "KHOAI" means 'potato'... random I know?! - I'll be back... maybe see you there
